subject: Technical onboarding checklist + issue escalation plan for Finovate POC
messages:
From: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>
To: Elena Morales <elena@finovate.io>, Product PM <pm@finovate.io>
Cc: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 10 Aug 2026 15:12:00 -0700
Subject: Technical onboarding checklist + issue escalation plan for Finovate POC

Hi Elena / team,

Thanks again for the call today — great alignment on scope.  As promised, summary of the proposed POC mechanics and the escalation rules so we can lock schedules on both sides. Please review and confirm by EOD Thursday so we can book the kickoff.

High-level success criteria (proposed):
- Latency: p95 < 200ms for the query profile we reviewed (300–1k token requests).
- Correctness: top-1 reranking precision >= 0.85 on your labeled eval set (see evaluation-template.md).
- Stability: API availability >= 99.95% during the evaluation window; no repeatable auth failures.

Evaluation plan / responsibilities:
- Data & harness: Finovate provides a labeled eval set + synthetic load script (Elena / PM).
- Redwood responsibilities: provide shared test endpoint, baseline runs, and a reproducible test harness (Jordan leads).
- Timeline: kickoff week of Aug 17; baseline runs by Aug 24; 1-week evaluation window Aug 24–31; decision review Sept 7.

Pre-req checklist (attached): redwood-poc-checklist.xlsx (network, VPC peering, test accounts), plus auth architecture diagram. Jordan, please flag any missing technical items.

Risk register (initial):
- AUTH: token refresh race under sustained clients — may surface at scale; mitigation: enable short-term refresh patch + monitoring.
- DATA: label skew between dev/test and prod — Finovate to provide representative slice.
- OPS: burst throughput > reserved capacity might cause throttling; recommend burst allowance for baseline runs.

Escalation path (if a blocking bug is found):
1) Customer/PM reports to Redwood SE (Jordan).
2) SE raises a P1 with Redwood Eng and cc: Markus Klein (Platform Eng lead).
3) If unresolved in 24 hours, Soojin will escalate to Account Exec + Sales Leadership for a temporary SLA accommodation.

Attachments: [Attachment: redwood-poc-checklist.xlsx (spreadsheet)], [Attachment: auth-architecture-diagram.png (image)], [Attachment: evaluation-template.md (markdown)].

Next steps (owner):
- Finovate: confirm success criteria + share eval set (Elena / PM) — by Thu EOD.
- Redwood (Jordan): validate network checklist and spin up test endpoint — by Aug 16.
- Redwood (Soojin): sign-off on commercial timeline and send SOW/DocuSign — by Aug 18.

Thanks — look forward to confirmation.

Best,
Soojin Lee
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
soojin_lee@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0192

From: Elena Morales <elena@finovate.io>

Cc: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 11 Aug 2026 09:04:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Technical onboarding checklist + issue escalation plan for Finovate POC

Thanks Soojin — this is helpful. A few clarifications from our side: 

- Success criteria: Can we add data-retention and audit log visibility as acceptance items? Our security team requires a 90-day logs retention window for the evaluation phase and a per-token/audit export.
- SOC2 evidence: procurement will ask for SOC 2 Type II summary (we have an internal template). Can you attach the SOC report or a short SOC evidence pack?
- Procurement contact: loop in Tom Henderson (tom@bigbank.com) on commercial items. He will own contract/PO timing.

On the timeline, Aug 17 kickoff works, but can Finovate get the test endpoint and a stable auth token by Aug 16? We need a day to run smoke tests before baseline.

I'll confirm the eval dataset delivery by Wed EOD. Also copying Product PM to confirm the labeled set schema.

On the auth risk: if there's any chance of an auth failure during the baseline, we need a documented workaround (short lived) so our QA can continue.

Elena
Director, Product | Finovate
elena@finovate.io

On Mon, Aug 10, 2026 at 03:12 PM Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com> wrote:

Date: Tue, 11 Aug 2026 13:20:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Technical onboarding checklist + issue escalation plan for Finovate POC

Thanks — quick technical notes and mitigation plan from the SE side.

Prereqs we need locked before Aug 16 smoke tests:
- VPC peering or IP allowlist + service account creds (we prefer VPC peering for throughput testing).
- Eval data format: newline-delimited JSON, with fields: id, prompt, expected (we'll use evaluation-template.md).
- Test harness: we'll provide a harness container and runbook.

Known technical risk that could be blocking: AUTH token refresh race (internal ticket ENG-459). Under heavy parallel refresh the server may return transient 401s for ~10s windows.
Mitigation plan:
- Short-term: enable client-side retry with exponential backoff + a token-refresh mutex in the harness (we'll supply updated SDK config by Aug 14).
- Patch: Eng will push a server-side fix targeted for Aug 26 (non-blocking for the baseline if retries are in place).
- Escalation: If your QA still sees persistent 401s after retries, mark as P1 and loop Markus (cc'd) to trigger an expedited hotfix.

Other items: we recommend increasing burst tokens to avoid throttling during baseline runs (we can enable a temporary burst policy for Aug 24 baseline).

I'll attach a short runbook in the shared Drive folder.

Jordan Blake
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
jordan_blake@redwood.com

Appreciate the quick replies — confirming final plan and owners so we can move to scheduling.

Confirmed items:
- Security/SOC: I'll attach the SOC evidence pack separately (Soojin to send by EOD). Our standard 90-day logs retention can be enabled for the evaluation window; Jordan will validate the audit export endpoint.
- Auth workaround: Jordan will provide the SDK patch and harness changes by Aug 14. Finovate to run smoke tests Aug 16 and report any 401s so we can evaluate impact.
- Baseline & burst: Redwood will enable temporary burst policy Aug 24 baseline; Jordan to confirm quota changes in HubSpot record HS-456789.

Final next steps (owner + due):
- Elena / PM: deliver labeled eval set + schema — due Wed Aug 12 EOD (owner: Finovate).
- Jordan: deliver SDK patch + runbook, validate network checklist — due Fri Aug 14.
- Soojin: upload SOC evidence pack + send SOW for signature (DocuSign link) — due Thu Aug 18.
- Markus: standby for P1 escalation; if ENG-459 resurfaces during the baseline, Markus will triage and commit to an ETA for a hotfix.

If anyone sees anything missing on the checklist I attached, flag it here. Once Elena confirms the eval set we will send calendar invites for kickoff.

Thanks all —
Soojin Lee
